summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 5, 2026, and the appointment of a new Chairman as part of a planned succession. All director nominees were re-elected, and other routine resolutions were passed. A director did not stand for re-election, and M. Kelly stepped down as Chairman, with J. Ndlovu appointed as his successor. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions or strategic changes; this is a routine governance update typically filed on Form 6-K by foreign private issuers.
